svg.title: Cumulative training cost is a one-time step; cumulative inference cost grows with usage and typically overtakes it
svg.desc: A line chart with time or usage on the horizontal axis and cumulative compute cost on the vertical axis. Training cost rises sharply once at the start and then stays flat, representing a bounded, front-loaded expense. Inference cost starts at zero and grows steadily over time as the deployed model serves ongoing traffic, crossing above the training cost line and continuing to grow for as long as the model stays in production.
svg.text: Training cost is front-loaded; inference cost accumulates with usage
